mn75:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadhammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agyāgāre tiṇasantharake.
mn75:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kammāsadhammaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn75:2.2: kammāsadhamme piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena aññataro vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya
mn75:2.3: taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
mn75:3.1: atha kho māgaṇḍiyo paribbājako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agyāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami.
mn75:3.2: addasā kho māgaṇḍiyo paribbājako bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agyāgāre tiṇasantharakaṃ
mn75:3.4: kassa navayaṃ samma bhoto bhāradvājassa agyāgāre tiṇasantharako paññatto samaṇaseyyānurūpaṃ maññeti.
mn75:4.1: atthi bho māgaṇḍiya samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito
mn75:4.2: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
mn75:4.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
mn75:5.3: ye mayaṃ tassa bhoto gotamassa bhūnahanassa seyyaṃ addasāmāti.
mn75:5.6: bahū hi tasseva bhoto gotamassa khattiyapaṇḍitāpi brāhmaṇapaṇḍitāpi gahapatipaṇḍitāpi samaṇapaṇḍitāpi abhippasannā vinītā ariye ñāye dhamme kusaleti.
mn75:5.7: sammukhā cepi mayaṃ bhāradvāja taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ passeyyāma sammukhāpi naṃ vadeyyāma
mn75:5.11: sace taṃ bhoto māgaṇḍiyassa agaru ārocessāmi tassa samaṇassa gotamassāti.
mn75:5.12: appossukko bhavaṃ bhāradvājo vutto ca naṃ vadeyyāti.
mn75:6.1: assosi kho bhagavā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusakāya bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa māgaṇḍiyena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
mn75:6.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agyāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā nisīdi paññatte tiṇasantharake.

mn75:6.8: atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo anakkhātaṃyeva akkhāsīti.

mn75:19.7: acchariyaṃ bho gotama abbhūtaṃ bho gotama
mn75:19.10: mayāpi kho etaṃ bho gotama sutaṃ pubbakānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
mn75:19.13: yaṃ pana te māgaṇḍiya sutaṃ pubbakānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
mn75:19.14: ārogyaparamā lābhā nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhanti katamantaṃ ārogyaṃ katamantaṃ nibbānanti.
mn75:19.15: evaṃ vutte māgaṇḍiyo paribbājako sakāneva sudaṃ gattāni pāṇinā anomajjati
mn75:19.16: idantaṃ bho gotama ārogyaṃ idantaṃ nibbānaṃ
mn75:19.17: ahaṃ bho gotama etarahi arogo sukhī na maṃ kiñci ābādhatīti.

mn75:20.12: chekaṃ vata bho odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucinti udāhu cakkhumato saddhāyāti.
mn75:20.13: ajānanto hi bho gotama apassanto asu so jaccandho puriso amuṃ telamasikataṃ sāhuḷacīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya paṭiggahetvā pārupeyya pārupetvā attamano attamanavācaṃ nicchāreyya
mn75:20.14: chekaṃ vata bho odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucinti udāhu cakkhumato saddhāyāti.
mn75:21.1: evameva kho māgaṇḍiya aññatitthiyā paribbājakā andhā acakkhukā ajānantā ārogyaṃ apassantā nibbānaṃ atha ca panimaṃ gāthaṃ bhāsanti
mn75:21.3: pubbakehesā māgaṇḍiya arahantehi sammāsambuddhehi gāthā bhāsitā
mn75:21.9: ayaṃ kho māgaṇḍiya kāyo rogabhūto gaṇḍabhūto sallabhūto aghabhūto ābādhabhūto so tvaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ rogabhūtaṃ gaṇḍabhūtaṃ sallabhūtaṃ aghabhūtaṃ ābādhabhūtaṃ
mn75:21.10: idantaṃ bho gotama ārogyaṃ idantaṃ nibbānanti vadesi.
mn75:21.11: taṃ hi te māgaṇḍiya ariyaṃ cakkhuṃ natthi yena tvaṃ ariyena cakkhunā ārogyaṃ jāneyyāsi nibbānaṃ passeyyāsīti.
mn75:22.2: pahoti me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ ārogyaṃ jāneyyaṃ nibbānaṃ passeyyanti.
mn75:22.4: na passeyya kaṇha sukkāni rūpāni na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni na passeyya mañjeṭṭhikāni rūpāni na passeyya samavisamaṃ na passeyya tārakarūpāni na passeyya candimasuriye.
mn75:22.5: tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ
mn75:22.6: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya
mn75:22.7: so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma na cakkhūni uppādeyya na cakkhūni visodheyya.
mn75:22.9: nanu so vejjo yāvadeva kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti.
mn75:22.11: evameva kho māgaṇḍiya ahañceva te dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
mn75:22.12: idantaṃ ārogyaṃ idantaṃ nibbānanti so tvaṃ ārogyaṃ na jāneyyāsi nibbānaṃ na passeyyāsi
mn75:22.13: so mamassa kilamatho sā mamassa vihesāti.
mn75:23.2: pahoti me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ ārogyaṃ nibbānaṃ passeyyanti.
mn75:23.4: so na passeyya kaṇha sukkāni rūpāni na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni na passeyya mañjeṭṭhikāni rūpāni na passeyya samavisamaṃ na passeyya tārakarūpāni na passeyya candimasuriye.
mn75:23.6: chekaṃ vata bho odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucinti.
mn75:23.8: tamenaṃ aññataro puriso telamasikatena sāhuḷacīvarena vañceyya
mn75:23.9: idante ambho purisa odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucinti.
mn75:23.11: tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ
mn75:23.12: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya
mn75:23.14: so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma cakkhūni uppādeyya cakkhūni visodheyya
mn75:23.15: tassa saha cakkhuppādā yo asukasmiṃ telamasikate sāhuḷacīvare chandarāgo so pahīyetha
mn75:23.16: tañcenaṃ purisaṃ amittatopi daheyya paccatthikatopi daheyya apica jīvitā voropetabbaṃ maññeyya
mn75:23.17: dīgharattaṃ vata bho ahaṃ iminā purisena telamasikatena sāhuḷacīvarena nikato vañcito paluddho
mn75:23.18: idante ambho purisa odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucinti
mn75:24.1: evameva kho māgaṇḍiya ahañceva te dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
mn75:24.3: so tvaṃ ārogyaṃ jāneyyāsi nibbānaṃ passeyyāsi
mn75:24.4: tassa te saha cakkhuppādā yo pañcasūpādānakkhandhesu chandarāgo so pahīyetha
mn75:24.6: dīgharattaṃ vata bho ahaṃ iminā cittena nikato vañcito paluddho
mn75:24.7: ahañca rūpaṃyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ vedanaṃyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ saññaṃyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ saṅkhāraṃyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ viññāṇaṃyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ
mn75:24.8: tassa me upādānapaccayā bhavo bhavapaccayā jāti jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassu pāyāsā sambhavanti
mn75:25.2: pahoti me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ imamhā āsanā anandho vuṭṭhaheyyanti.
mn75:25.4: yato kho tvaṃ māgaṇḍiya sappurise bhajessasi tato tvaṃ māgaṇḍiya saddhammaṃ sossasi
mn75:25.5: yato kho tvaṃ māgaṇḍiya saddhammaṃ sossasi tato tvaṃ māgaṇḍiya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjissasi
mn75:25.6: yato kho tvaṃ māgaṇḍiya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjissasi tato tvaṃ māgaṇḍiya sāmaṃyeva ñassasi sāmaṃ dakkhissasi
mn75:25.8: idha rogā gaṇḍā sallā aparisesā nirujjhanti
mn75:25.9: tassa me upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho bhavanirodhā jātinirodho jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassu pāyāsā nirujjhanti
mn75:26.1: evaṃ vutte māgaṇḍiyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn75:26.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
mn75:26.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
mn75:26.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn75:26.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
mn75:27.1: yo kho māgaṇḍiya aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ so cattāro māse parivasati catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya
mn75:27.3: sace bhante aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyāti.
mn75:28.1: alattha kho māgaṇḍiyo paribbājako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
mn75:28.2: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā māgaṇḍiyo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
mn75:28.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn75:28.4: aññataro kho panāyasmā māgaṇḍiyo arahataṃ ahosīti.
